description: This file contains PHP unit tests for the I18NImportErrorAPI class, focusing on testing the API endpoints related to internationalization import errors within the admin API module of the orangehrm project. It includes setup routines, test cases for retrieving all import errors, and tests for unimplemented create and delete methods.

classes.name: I18NImportErrorAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the I18NImportErrorAPI endpoints related to internationalization import error management within the admin API module of the orangehrm project.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, truncates specific database tables, and populates test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' method of the I18NImportErrorAPI, verifying retrieval of import error records.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'testGetAll' method, sourcing data from a YAML configuration file.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Ensures that the create operation is currently unimplemented and throws the appropriate exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Checks that the validation rule for creation is unimplemented and throws the expected exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the delete method is unimplemented and triggers the correct exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that the validation rule for delete is unimplemented and throws the expected exception.
